name: SteamVeil / dismemberment

request.text: Single dry close positional game sound effect. Immediate attack, self-contained fade, no voice, no scream, no breath, no words, no music, no ambience, no weapon firing, no reverb. A taut soaked tissue snap with a tight pressurized steam jet and hot water droplets sputtering out. One fast wet severing onset followed by a short white vapor release.
